openIssues: The recording was produced by the web composition; permission/preset, sandbox/mode, approval/policy, command/* and agent/inbox/spliced rows are reproduced by the fixture host, while web-only UI rows do not exist in this flow.

The recorded round-1/round-2 bash commands inspected the dsh checkout; the fixture replaces them with get_goal calls so the workspace stays neutral. The assistant text is fixture-authored, not recording-derived.
The recording logs system/message once per session; the fixture host mirrors that (turn 1 step 1 only).
Recording rows excluded from alignment are listed in alignment.excludedRecordingRows; they are host-level or web-only and do not affect goal state.

validation.eventSequence: Goal-relevant skeleton matches the recording rows 1-101: command/run -> goal/change create -> command/done -> next-turn splice -> turn/start -> splice removal -> step/start -> system/message -> goal user/message -> request/header initial -> assistant/tool events -> turn/end completed -> next-turn splice round 2 -> turn/start -> user/message round 2 -> request/header series -> update_goal -> goal/change complete -> wrap-up splice -> user/message <goal_complete> -> closing assistant -> turn/end completed. Omitted recording rows: web-only runtime-context user messages, job/registered and job/settled, and the extra bash steps of the live recording.

update_goal complete -> goal/change complete -> tool/result -> next-step wrap-up splice
wrap-up user/message -> closing assistant message -> turn/end completed
